title: Conditions of Exchange — Northbeam Returns and Restocking
content:
These are the exchange terms Northbeam Electronics publishes for each Northbeam Returns and Restocking schedule. Whether the line may be exchanged instead of refunded, the days from the window anchor within which an exchange may be raised, how a price difference on an exchange is settled, whether the old item is taken away when an exchange is delivered, and whether a protection plan on the returned item is cancelled with the return, are set against the schedule the line falls under.

| Return schedule | Exchange allowed | Exchange window | How a price difference is settled |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | yes | 15 days | the difference is charged or refunded at today's shelf price |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | yes | 30 days | the difference is charged or refunded at today's shelf price |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | yes | 2 days | the difference is charged or refunded at today's shelf price |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | yes | 14 days | an exchange is like for like only |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | no | 0 days | not applicable |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | yes | 45 days | the difference is settled against the contract price book |

| Return schedule | Old item taken away with the exchange | Protection plan cancelled with the return |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | no | yes |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | yes | yes |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | yes | yes |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | no | yes |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | no | yes |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | yes | yes |

**Term note 1.** On every schedule but one the exchange window is the same number of days as that schedule's return window; the terms publish them as two figures against one schedule, and the exchange window is the figure read for an exchange.

**Term note 2.** Three different difference bases appear in these terms. Three schedules settle at today's shelf price, one settles like for like and therefore settles no difference at all, one settles against the contract price book, and on the final sale schedule the basis is published as not applicable because no exchange is allowed on it.

**Term note 3.** A protection plan on the returned item is cancelled with the return on all six schedules; the haul-away of the replaced item stands only on the three schedules that deliver by crew or on the member schedule.
